amends.rule: the S53 registration is not edited. This amendment supersedes only the stage-3 FLOPs clause and its role in the win; the loop, teacher, student, R=1 bit-identity test and the accuracy clause stand unchanged.

reason.near_automatic_ratio: The registered stage-3 win compared R=4 greedy against stage-2 maj@16 and required at most 0.30 of its FLOPs. Four greedy passes against sixteen sampled answers is a ratio near 0.125 before any prefill accounting, so passing 0.30 is arithmetic rather than evidence that the loop is efficient.
reason.evidence: The experimental claim is the accuracy clause: greedy R=4 must close at least two thirds of the stage-2 greedy-to-maj@16 gap on both tasks. That is the result the experiment can fail.
reason.guard: The FLOPs bound still matters as a guard against a loop that closes the gap by spending more compute than the maj@16 baseline. It is retained at the registered 0.30, but satisfying it is never cited as a win on its own.

stage_3_win.evidence_clause: greedy R=4 beats stage-2 greedy on a prompt-level paired 95% interval above zero AND closes at least two thirds of the stage-2 greedy-to-maj@16 gap on BOTH GSM8K and MATH-500
stage_3_win.guard_clause: R=4 greedy prefill + decode FLOPs per answer <= 0.30 of stage-2 maj@16 FLOPs per answer, from the executed set
stage_3_win.no_softening: a FLOPs ratio below the bound does not substitute for the accuracy clause; a miss on the accuracy clause is not rescued by an efficient loop
stage_3_win.reporting: the receipt reports the executed-set FLOPs per answer for R=4 greedy and stage-2 maj@16, the ratio, the accuracy deltas and their prompt-level paired intervals. The ratio is labelled a guard in the receipt.

near_automatic_value.basis: four greedy passes against sixteen sampled answers, decode-dominated; not a measurement and not used as a win

does_not_change: the looped layers 8-15, zero-init re-entry gate, zero-init per-pass depth-LoRA and the R=1 bit-identity test
the privileged teacher (maj@16 consensus that is also verified against the training label)
the stage-2 and stage-4 accuracy comparisons
the executed-set audit and its parameter/FLOPs identities
